Comment on Blueberry Bread Pudding by Ruth
item.description: Hello! If there’s any way that you could please provide me with the recipe for your traditional bread pudding? And also the Carmel chocolate tarts you once had listed in the blog? I made the bread pudding a lot but all of my recipes were lost in a fire and I can’t remember the proportions. Also the white sauce for it too if possible. The one published was caramel. The tarts were my go to treat whenever you had them but it seems they’re no longer being made. So if you don’t have that, it’s fine.
